Multi-market checkout monitoring. Catch geo breaks before buyers do.

Synthetic checkout tests on 8 markets (US, CA, GB, FR, DE, AE, ZA, AU)—not a single-country ping. Generate tests, pick markets/devices, walk product → cart → checkout presentation. No real payments or orders. Market Health: baseline vs localization. Evidence: score, video, screenshots, PDF. Alerts after a confirmed repeat. Scope: read_products only. Pro: multi-market for one shop. Agency: portfolio + white-label. Support: support@frictionobservatory.com — we reply within 1 business day (Mon–Fri)
